グラウンドに行くと、パイロットスーツを着ている七彩が、\nダッシュをしながらタイ:
When I went to the field, Nanairo was sprinting in her pilot suit
and timing her runs.
ハァ……ハァ……タイム更新まで、あと少しですわね……！: Hah... Hah... Just a little more to beat my time...!
七彩、どうしたんだ？\n一人でそんなに走り込んで……:
Nanairo, what's going on?
You're really pushing yourself out here alone...
あ……%usernameusernameuserna%さん。\nふぅ……その……:
Oh... %usernameusernameuserna%-san.
Whew... Well... I've had something on my mind.
新しいパイロットスーツ……新しい機体……環境が大きく変わる今こそ、\nわたくしは:
A new pilot suit... A new machine... With so much changing around us,
I have a duty as team leader to set an example for everyone.
……だからこそ、今までの壁を超えたいのです。\nわたくし自身が皆さんに誇れるよう:
...That's why I want to push past my limits.
To become someone I can be proud of in front of them.
……その心がけは立派だと思うが……無理は禁物だぞ？: ...That's admirable... But don't overdo it, okay?
分かっていますわ。ちゃんと自分の体調管理はしていますのよ。: I know. I'm keeping a careful eye on my condition.
……とはいえ、七彩は頑張りすぎちまうきらいがあるからな。\n教導指揮官として、俺:
...Even so, you do tend to push yourself too hard, Nanairo.
As your Instructional Commander, mind if I help with your training?
えっ？ かまいませんけども……本当によろしいんですの？\nやっていることはわたく:
Huh? I don't mind, but... Are you sure?
This is only my individual training, you know.
ひとりでやるよりも、タイムを測るやつとか、\n客観的に見るやつとかがいた方がいい:
Better than being on your own, right? You could use someone to time you
and watch with a fresh pair of eyes.
……ありがとうございます、%usernameusernameuserna%さん。:
...Thank you, %usernameusernameuserna%-san.
Then I'll gladly accept your help.
ああ、任せろ。さっそくだが、もう一回走ってもらえるか？\nフォームからちゃんと見:
Yeah, leave it to me. First, can you run once more?
I'll start by taking a proper look at your form.
それから俺は七彩の走りをチェックし、\n彼女の特訓にしばし付き合うのだった。:
After that, I checked Nanairo's running form
and helped her with her training for a while.
七彩がそこまで言うなら、無理はしないって信じるよ。: If you're that sure, Nanairo, I'll trust you not to overdo it.
ふふ、信用していただけて何よりです。\nではわたくしはもう少しだけトレーニングを:
Hehe, I'm glad you trust me.
Then I'll carry on training a little longer...
そう言って走り始めた七彩を見送った後、\n俺は飲み物を買ってからもう一度七彩の元:
After watching Nanairo start running again,
I bought a drink and went back to her.
頑張ってる七彩に差し入れだ。\n走って汗をかいた後なら、水分補給は大切だろ？:
A little something for all your hard work, Nanairo.
You've been running and sweating. Gotta stay hydrated, right?
……ありがとうございます、%usernameusernameuserna%さん。:
...Thank you, %usernameusernameuserna%-san.
I am rather thirsty, so I'll gladly have it.
折角ですし、このまま休憩いたしましょうか。\nもしよければ、話し相手になってくだ:
Since you're here, shall we take a break?
Would you keep me company for a little chat?
ああ、俺で良ければ。: Sure, if you don't mind my company.
そうして、七彩の休憩に付き添いながら、\n俺は彼女としばらく穏やかな時間を過ごす:
And so, I kept Nanairo company on her break,
and we spent a little quiet time together.
